summary: The final step is publishing the tarball to Galaxy, Red Hat Automation Hub or a private Automation Hub, either with ansible-galaxy collection publish or through the server's website.
questions: Can I upload a collection through the Galaxy website instead of the CLI?
Where can I publish a built collection tarball?

answer_card.title: Ways to publish a collection
answer_card.answer_md: Publish the tarball to Galaxy, Red Hat Automation Hub or a private Automation Hub, either with `ansible-galaxy collection publish` or via the server's website.
